scope: Targeted OpenAPI EN/KO technical-contract editorial comparison, not independent all-sentence certification

reviewed_claims.evidence: English explicitly lists local component refs, local reference chains and local Path Item references. Korean now includes all three plus read/write classification from the HTTP method.

Korean now states default style/explode serialization is compiled into the endpoint contract and included in the schema fingerprint. Unsupported styles and allowReserved fail closed, and report findings are retained.
Korean now states response bytes are streamed and capped before JSON/text decoding even when Content-Length is omitted or misreported.

Compared credential partitioning, same-origin policy, JSON root/null and oneOf bodies, reference-resolution bounds and fail-closed restrictions, nested fields, YAML resource limits, and amendment scope; existing Korean prose carries the observed critical qualifiers.

limitations: Technical-contract risk review of one documentation pair only. No second-person attestation of all sentences or other 146 bilingual page pairs.
